Senior Frontend Engineer
Lumen Banking Ltd · London (Hybrid, 2 days in office)

The role
You will own the customer-facing web app used by 400,000 small businesses.

Responsibilities
• Build accessible, performant UI in React and TypeScript
• Collaborate with designers on our component library
• Mentor mid-level engineers

Requirements
• 5+ years building web applications with JavaScript, at least 2 with TypeScript
• Deep knowledge of React, including hooks and state management
• Strong CSS skills (we use CSS Modules)
• Hands-on experience with web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
• No financial services background required

Nice to have
• Next.js
• React Testing Library or Playwright
• Experience contributing to design systems

What we offer
• £85,000–£100,000 plus equity
• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, pension with 6% employer contribution
• £1,500 annual learning budget, cycle to work scheme
• Visa sponsorship available

Lumen is committed to building a diverse team and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
Questions? Contact talent@lumenbank.example
